findings.text: the optional leading slash in _PATH_TOKEN at :67 consumes the slash of a './'-prefixed relative path, so './docs/x.md' derives '/docs/x.md' and the while loop at :309 never fires; against the landed module the token list is ['/docs/x.md'], a path the fence then treats as outside the repository and the queue-time existence check skips, which is the failure class this section exists to prevent.
assert ABSOLUTE_RECORD.startswith('/') asserts a property of the test's own literal and cannot fail for any behaviour of the code under test, so it adds no coverage to the case it sits in.

the fragment states that only a leading './' relative prefix is dropped, which the landed _PATH_TOKEN does not do: a './'-prefixed path comes back absolute, so the record describes behaviour the change does not have.
the artifacts line reports ruff check and ruff format --check clean, but no log under logs/ captures either run, so the done_when's ruff clause rests on an unrecorded claim.
